entity.name: Altruva Lab
entity.description: Altruva Lab is an open-source AI research initiative building foundational infrastructure for causal reasoning, AI education, and intelligent system design. Our work focuses on helping developers, researchers, and educators understand not only how modern AI systems work, but why they evolved and how they can be designed responsibly. We maintain the LINEAGE curriculum, ATLAS-AI causal reasoning engine, and ATLAS-SDK system architecture generator. Together these projects form an open ecosystem for understanding, teaching, and building artificial intelligence systems through causal reasoning rather than isolated pattern learning.

projects.name: LINEAGE
projects.description: LINEAGE is an open-source framework that maps the causal evolution of artificial intelligence from first principles to modern architectures. It transforms fragmented AI knowledge into structured learning pathways that help developers understand system design, architectural trade-offs, and the historical progression of machine intelligence.

projects.name: ATLAS-AI
projects.description: ATLAS-AI is an open-source causal reasoning engine trained on structured knowledge graphs that explain the evolution of artificial intelligence. Unlike traditional language models that focus primarily on prediction, ATLAS-AI focuses on explaining why technologies emerged, what constraints they solved, and how future breakthroughs may evolve.

projects.name: ATLAS-SDK
projects.description: ATLAS-SDK is an open-source system generation toolkit that converts problem descriptions into AI system architectures, implementation scaffolds, and evolution roadmaps. It helps engineers move from problem definition to deployable system designs grounded in causal understanding and architectural best practices.
